purpose: Sexual fungus-gnat lifecycle with explicit egg/larva/pupa/adult stages, fungal/root feeding, mating, oviposition and short adult lifespan.

temperatureSigmaC.notes: Response-shape parameter around the reference condition.

larvalDevelopmentDays.notes: Sum of four reported larval instar means: 3.3 + 3.1 + 1.8 + 5.9 d.

pupalDevelopmentDays.notes: Mean pupa duration at about 24 C.

adultLifespanDays.notes: Mean adult longevity at about 24 C.

preOvipositionHours.notes: Direct evidence is <24 h when males are present; 18 h is a bounded implementation value.

fecundityEggsPerFemale.notes: Mean at about 24 C; reported range 12-156.

femaleProbability.notes: Recent laboratory report gives female:male ratio about 2:1.

larvalFeedingCarbonMgPerSecond.notes: Larvae are mycophagous and can consume plant tissue; carbon rate is not directly measured.

fungusPreference.notes: Fungi treated as preferred food; root tissue is fallback.

adultCarbonTargetMg.notes: No robust species-specific body-carbon estimate was found in the Phase-5 pass.

initialLarvaCarbonMg.notes: Initial individual material for lifecycle tests.

eggCarbonMg.notes: Material cost per egg; bounded by female body material and fecundity.

moistureHalfSaturationWaterG.notes: Maps substrate-water pool to oviposition/development suitability; not a direct RH conversion.

ovipositionMoistureThreshold.notes: Moist substrate is a lifecycle requirement.

adultFlightMetabolismMultiplier.notes: Represents aerial activity cost without yet simulating 3D flight paths.

pupationCarbonFractionOfAdult.notes: Engineering critical-mass gate: larvae that have not accumulated sufficient biomass remain larvae instead of pupating on thermal time alone. Value must be sensitivity-tested.

immatureSurvivalProbability.notes: Laboratory immature survival reported around 46.4% across the study temperature range. Because stage-specific mortality is unavailable, post-start offspring receive one aggregate viability draw when eggs enter the feeding larval cohort; pre-start seeded larvae receive the same aggregate draw at adult emergence. This is an implementation placement of aggregate mortality, not a claim that all deaths occur at one biological stage.

reproductionReserveFraction.notes: Minimum adult reserve fraction retained before egg allocation. Realized brood size is limited by reserve carbon above this floor while fecundityEggsPerFemale remains the measured laboratory upper/mean target. Raised from 0.20 using Phase-7 calibration seeds 0-2 after 60-day closed-system runs produced ~5k-7k larvae despite removal of global plant-root fallback. Final calibration is 0.30 so the explicitly seeded integrated adult pair (reserve fraction 0.35) remains reproductively capable at world start. CALIBRATED engineering value; validation seeds were not used for tuning and this is not a measured lipid fraction.
